# observability

RED signals per operation, tracing coverage and alarms that can actually notify - the OTel contract plus CloudWatch alarm posture.

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-OBS-001` | medium | CloudWatch alarm exists but its actions are disabled |
| `AF-OBS-002` | high | CloudWatch alarm declares no action targets |
| `AF-OBS-003` | low | Step Functions state machine has X-Ray tracing disabled |
